content: Morning in Phandalin after long rest. Party prepares to split tasks: Zephyr will meet Gwyn Oresong at the apothecary to begin research on psionic goblin specimens, while the rest of the party will report findings to Harbin Wester.

Zephyr and Gwyn Oresong begin research on psionic goblin specimens, focusing on neural pathways and crystal interface with the brain. Party reports to Harbin about practical threats: psionic goblins still active, commander fled, underground tunnels discovered.
Zephyr begins research with Gwyn Oresong (1-2 day process). Party focuses on addressing Harbin's concerns about immediate threats and planning next steps for the investigation.
Party decides to help organize Phandalin's defenses first, then hunt the escaped goblin commander. Commander is injured and couldn't have gone far.
Vandross tracking wounded goblin commander into the forest with Eglath's help.
Party rushes the cave to attack the wounded goblin psi commander directly.

Party successfully defeated and captured the wounded Goblin Psi Commander. Brevin choked it unconscious after team effort: Vandross (2 flying knees), Eglath (raging punch), Torgga (mace strike), Brevin (chokehold).

Party successfully secured the unconscious Goblin Psi Commander: blindfolded, gagged, hogtied to a stick. Eglath and Vandross carry it between them back to Phandalin to deliver to Zephyr for research.

Party successfully contained the live Goblin Psi Commander in the old guardhouse containment cell. Creature is blindfolded, gagged, and fully restrained on a reinforced table. Maximum security measures in place. Ready for Zephyr's Phase 2 research when preliminary research is complete.

Party sets up elaborate ambush at guardhouse using captured commander as bait. Kill box design: lure goblins inside, trap with pike wall behind them, rain arrows from rooftops. 20 militia deployed. Waiting for 22-goblin search party to arrive.
Ambush sprung successfully. 22 goblins trapped inside guardhouse. Door barred by Sildar from outside. Archers firing from rooftops, party attacking from inside. Kill box executed perfectly.

Guardhouse ambush successful. 22 goblins killed (16 regulars, 6 psi brawlers), 2 captured alive. All bodies delivered to Zephyr's lab for research. Captured goblins shackled in guardhouse cells. Commander remains secured and sedated. Major victory against goblin threat.

Party sacrificed Venomfang's dragon heart to Zephyr. He will create 5 psionic disruptor devices (one per party member) ready by dawn. 30-ft cone, 3 charges/day, DC 15 INT save, suppresses psionic abilities. Work begins immediately - 12-15 hour timeline.
Party takes short rest near Barthen's Well before descending into underground tunnels. Time to heal and prepare for exploration of goblin tunnels leading toward Zorzula's Rest.
